notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, Rendezvous Point, a Hidden Base marker, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well and Squadron Assignments; they count toward the 60. Two Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

The starting line '3rd effect depends..more in strategy section' is a comment, not a card, and is dropped. The strategy says the third starting Effect is Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice (against Imperial Command decks) or Menace Fades (against MKOS); both are in the Effects list.
The starting line '<Hidden Base Marker>' names no card; it is printed as written (UNKNOWN) and counted, which makes the total 60.

Posted 'Endor' dested the Light Endor system (Endor set); 'Kiffex' dested the Light Kiffex (Jabba's Palace); 'Do Or Do Not And Wise Advice' dested the Reflections II combo Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'I'll Take The Leader - Admiral's Order' dested the Admiral's Order I'll Take The Leader.

The post's 'decklist errors' update says to replace a Kessel with Mon Calamari, an A Few Maneuvers with Bacta Tank, and an Organized Attack and a Darklighter Spin with 2x Star Destroyer!; the list is kept as published.
Cards he wants to add (Aim High, Order To Engage, 2x Rebel Barrier) are not in the list.
